title: Verified facts of harness discovery
description: The record of one verified fact about a harness (feature 146, T003). T027, T028 and T029 — the person-run and macOS-run probes of phase 6 — append these records by hand; discovery itself writes none, and the product reads them as data. One record states what was checked, of which subject, on which date, and what the check found.

date.description: The date the check was run (a calendar date, not a timestamp).

subject.description: What the fact is about: a harness id, an endpoint host, or a gateway.

check.description: The question the check asked, as a short name plus what was done.

name.description: The short name of the check, e.g. model-list-unbilled or gateway-cross-provider.

method.description: How the check was performed, so a reader can repeat it.

result.description: What the check found, with the observed evidence.

outcome.description: The answer of the check: confirmed, refuted, inconclusive, or unverified — unverified is the outcome of a live check the owner ruling of 2026-09-30 reserves to a person (T027, T028 and the macOS runner of T029); the build records it with its reason in the evidence and never runs the live part.

evidence.description: What was observed, as data; never a credential.

runBy.description: Who ran the check (a person, for T027 to T029).
